Message:
I can hear people’s voices coming
from the cursed creatures...
Many of them, at that...

That reminds me—
there was a story
I heard once from Mother...

About how only the song
of “Primavera” can soothe
the wandering souls of the dead...

Was that not just a legend,
but the truth...?

If so, then that must be why
the ones who bear
the name “Primavera”
come here every year
to pacify the dead
with their songs...

I then focused my ears,
and listened closer
to the voices echoing
within the fog...

Deep grief and despair...
Lingering attachment
to this world...
Resentment from having
their futures taken away...

The laments of those who
could not be saved
echo sadly through the air...

If all that lament gathered
at the bottom of this lake
is what created these
cursed creatures, then...

If I can soothe all of their hearts
with my song,

these cursed creatures
will surely be pacified as well...!

It will be alright...
If I can just
sing like Mother...!
